factor: At an original confirmed 12H entry keep only contracts whose own current ATR14/close is at least its rolling 96-bar mean. Both windows end at the completed key candle. Keep the frozen low prior ATR priority, nine cash-sharing slots, 2/3 at 2R and 1/3 original EMA runner. No other threshold.
motivation: Different earlier detector and timeframe in docs/learnings/volatility-level-and-volatility-expansion-are-opposite-axes.md suggested that within-contract expansion differs from absolute volatility across contracts. This study uses the native cloud Wilder ATR14; no effect from the earlier study is assumed transferable.
market_data: Complete aligned 12H OHLC only; Wilder resets on gaps and rolling mean must have 96 consecutive finite ATRs. Match the closed 12H key to its immediately following actual H1 open. Missing ratios never confer eligibility. Each non-signal control must independently have expansion at its own clock.
decision: Compare with the unconditioned frozen account. Only after >=100 dev trades, >=30% wins, return and dollar payoffs >=2.5, and <=35% hourly DD bound in development, run paired controls and additional 5bp slippage. Transfer unchanged to corrected Binance history only if both dev and full pass. All later years used by earlier strategy selection.
costs: Real market 5bp, resting limit 2bp on filled notional. No funding or market impact modeled.
